name: Veil Masquerade #19
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Twin horns. Aperture: Slot. Ornament: Herringbone. Palette: Bone + lilac. Hem: Scalloped. Its palette is shared with one other in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
